span.p:
1. Control plane upgrade
(no workload restart; API stays available)

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
2. Fixed-size node pools one AZ at a time:
maxSurge 1 / maxUnavailable 0,
cordon → drain (PDB respected) → reimage,
node soak time before next node
(only when nodes must be replaced)

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
Guardrails per StatefulSet
• ≥ 3 replicas, one per AZ (topologySpreadConstraints)
• PDB maxUnavailable 1
• Premium_ZRS / StandardSSD_ZRS disks: pod can move zone
• readiness gates on replication / quorum

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
When – only when absolutely necessary
• OS security patches: in place on existing nodes,
inside maintenance windows (dev → acc → prd staggered)
• Kubernetes patch: only for security / bug / support,
control plane only where possible
• LTS minor: kept as long as LTS lasts, upgraded in the
last 6 months of LTS support, dev → acc → prd
